tour.title: Search by what's in your files
tour.source: Pixel 8 Pro emulator, Android 17, build 5, sample data
tour.overview: Describe what you're looking for in your own words. Exact words, names and codes are found at once; meaning fills in a moment later, across languages.
highlights: “can I keep a cat in the flat” → Lease 2026.pdf, page 3 (Pets and noise)
“INV-2026-0417” → Invoice INV-2026-0417.pdf, by its exact code
“hilsa fish recipe” (English) → the Bengali note ইলিশ রান্না.txt, first

tour.title: Photos and screenshots by what they show
tour.source: Pixel 8 Pro emulator, Android 17, build 5, sample data
tour.overview: Pictures are searched by what's in them, not their names. The Pictures filter shows matches as a grid.
highlights: “mountains by a lake” → mountain_lake.jpg (Pictures filter)
“dog running on the beach at sunset” → beach_sunset.jpg
“screenshot of a payment error” → the Payment declined screenshot

tour.title: Choose what to index
tour.source: Pixel 8 Pro emulator, Android 17, build 5, sample data
tour.overview: Tick documents, PDFs and pictures. Files already indexed and unchanged are skipped, and nothing is embedded twice.
highlights: 19 files read; all 21 pieces (13 text, 8 pictures) searchable by meaning
The next run: 0 new or changed · 19 skipped · 21 embedded, nothing read twice
Before it, a caution: “7 documents, 4 PDFs, 8 pictures” are already in the index

tour.title: Refresh folders, system folders protected
tour.source: Pixel 8 Pro emulator, Android 17, build 5, sample data
tour.overview: Tap Refresh under Phone storage or SD card to list folders made since; new ones are marked New. Android's system folders and other apps' files are never shown or read.
highlights: A folder made after opening the app: Refresh says “1 new folder: Scans”, marked New
LOST.DIR, a hidden folder and Android/ exist on the device and are never listed
A folder removed meanwhile drops out of the list

tour.title: Download the model in the app
tour.source: Rendered by TourScreenshotTest (the download wasn't run on the emulator)
tour.overview: Search by meaning needs a one-time 865 MB download over Wi-Fi. It resumes if interrupted and is checked before use; nothing about your files is sent.
highlights: Waits for Wi-Fi, shows progress, and stops on request
Each file's SHA-256 is checked before it's used

tour.title: Fits every screen
tour.overview: Phones from small ldpi screens to the Pixel 8 Pro, tablets and landscape, with large text: nothing overlaps or is cut off, and the app runs edge to edge on Android 15 to 17.
highlights: Checked from ldpi to xxxhdpi, on a tablet, in landscape and at 200% text
Edge to edge on the Pixel 8 Pro emulator, Android 17

tour.title: This tour, after every update
tour.overview: The tour opens once after you install or update OmniFind. Open it again any time from Engine → What's new.
highlights: Shown after an update (build 5 → 6 on the emulator); not again on relaunch
Seven numbered steps, then the fixes and known issues

tour.title: Help, from the menu
tour.overview: Tap ⋮ at the top of any screen for Help: a user guide with articles about every feature, and the release notes of every version. Search both from the top of Help.
highlights: Nine articles in three groups, starting with Getting started
Release notes from 0.3.0-beta.1 to this build
Back from an article returns to the same place in the guide

fixes.title: Content no longer runs under the status and navigation bars on Android 15–17
The privacy note no longer covers the examples on short screens and in landscape
Buttons, tags and chips no longer cut words off at large text sizes or on 320 dp screens
Thumbnails are sharp on every density (they asked for a fixed pixel size)
Launcher icon in every density bucket, round and themed (Android 13+) versions
"All files access" on Android 11+ and notification permission on 13+
A folder reached through a link, or a path back into Android/, is refused
The caution before indexing says PDFs, not pdfs
The build number in the app always matches the release

known: Scanned PDFs (pages without text) are not searchable yet: planned for milestone 4.
Text inside screenshots isn't searchable by its exact words; screenshots are found by what they show.
arm64 phones only. On newer CPUs (Pixel 8 Pro) the engine doesn't yet use their faster instructions.

oneLine: Menu, User Guide and Release Notes in the app

new: A menu on every screen (⋮): Settings, Dashboard and Help.
Help: a user guide of nine articles, from getting started to privacy, with screenshots of the app.
Release notes for every version, inside the app.
Search the guide and the release notes from the Help screen.
improved: Articles remember where you were: going back returns you to the same place in the guide.
Article text can be made larger with Aa.
fixed: The build number in the app always matches the release (it could lag a build behind).
